# Vetlas

Indore-first veterinary directory. Public-source research, not medical advice or independent verification of medical quality. Provider facts checked 2026-11-15. Confirm current fees and availability directly.

- [Veterinarians in Indore](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/indore/veterinarians/)
- [Veterinarian dataset with identity notes and sources](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/veterinarians.json)
- [Interactive clinic map](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/map/)
- [Indore directory](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/indore/)
- [Public dataset with evidence links](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/directory.json)
- [Consultation fee comparison](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/costs/)
- [Methodology](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/methodology/)

15 researched facilities are currently included. No first-party reviews have been published. Reddit discussions are anecdotal and may refer to other branches. All 15 facilities have sourced positions from public Google Maps place geometry, published Plus Code cell centres (approximately 14 m), or a provider-linked Google Maps destination. Each record retains method, source URL and check date. Entrances are not independently surveyed. The comparison map uses OpenStreetMap; Google Maps provides selected-location previews and directions. Nine veterinarian profiles are alphabetical, not a clinical ranking. Published qualifications are attributed, not independently verified. H. K. Mehta / Hemant Mehta identity is requester-confirmed; B. P. Shukla’s current private consulting location remains unconfirmed. Facility ratings must not be treated as doctor ratings. Platform rating means use available sourced scores with equal weight, one value per platform, never pooled review counts. Coverage is incomplete; snapshots may be old and Justdial may overlap with other platforms. Original public-source facility photos have source links, original image URLs and check dates. Google Maps score snapshots were manually observed, with counts omitted when unavailable. Optional live Google Places media and ratings still require setup. Dr. Nigam fee sources conflict. Dogsvilla's fee is a starting figure. Missing costs are unknown, never zero. Small selected-list means are not city-wide averages.

Community total-visit cost voting: GET /api/cost-votes/{provider-id} returns a live aggregate with band counts and a midpoint-based estimated mean. Exact amounts override midpoints; open-ended votes without amounts are excluded from the mean. Values are anonymous self-reports, not verified invoices. Fewer than ten votes are labelled small samples. No synthetic votes are seeded. One current vote per browser/facility, with updates and deletion; not unique-person verification.

All 15 facility records include sourced visitHours with schedule and observation date. Separate doctor sessions are not clinic opening hours. consultationListing contains conflicting or historical prices with explicit notes; these are excluded from fee averages. Five veterinarian portraits are identified by name on clinic websites or doctor directory pages, with source and original image URL preserved.

## Pune & Pimpri-Chinchwad — public-source research (2026-11-16)

- [Pune city directory](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/pune/): 88 researched facility records and 33 Pune/PCMC veterinarian profiles. They are public-source observations, not independently verified clinical quality or credentials.
- [Pune veterinarian directory](https://vetlas.thatvetguy.net/pune/veterinarians/): individual practitioners and attributed practice associations.
- [Pune research plan](https://github.com/HappyRancho/Vetlas/blob/main/docs/PUNE-DIRECTORY-PLAN.md) and [research log](https://github.com/HappyRancho/Vetlas/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH-LOG-PUNE.md) document access limitations, conflicting details and areas pending verification.

Pune records include low-confidence candidates and information obtained from search snippets, not solely direct business websites. LinkedIn profiles were not accessible during research. Confirm locations, contact numbers, hours and emergency capability with each provider. The Pune city hub and unvetted profile pages are excluded from search indexing while their publication gates remain closed. The /map/, /costs/, /directory.json and /veterinarians.json endpoints remain Indore-specific.
